scope: Issues observed during clean local bootstrap validation, before publication

observations.issue: The pinned CMake package was installed but its executable was absent from PATH in an unactivated virtual environment
observations.repair: Select the executable directory from the verified cmake Python package explicitly

observations.issue: Modern CMake FindPython ignored the upstream legacy PYTHON_EXECUTABLE flag and selected another installed Python
observations.observed_failure: Python 3.10 extension built for a Python 3.12 runtime; isolated-engine activation rejected a global-module fallback
observations.repair: Provide a CMake toolchain file pinning Python_EXECUTABLE, Python3_EXECUTABLE and PYTHON_EXECUTABLE to the active interpreter
observations.configure_probe: PASS: CMake selected the active Python 3.12.3 interpreter and development headers

provenance: Each output archive includes the interpreter toolchain file and its SHA256. Every retry uses a separate setup directory. The frozen builder, native patch and statistical files remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
